OTV-S700 SDI output ports

The OTV-S700 has separate HD recording and 4K outputs. For the XR connection, we first tested 12G-SDI, then used HD OUT3, which provided an SBS image.

HD recording output
HD OUT3 · RECORDER

The menu offers HD-SDI or 3G-SDI. We used HD-SDI with Always 3D for this connection.

4K · Quad-Link
3G-SDI (4K) A–D

These four ports form a set, carrying one 4K signal across four SDI links.

4K · Single-Link
12G-SDI OUT1·OUT2

Each output can carry a 4K signal over a single cable.

A Quad-Link receiver uses all four A–D links together to reconstruct one 4K image.

Video received from 12G-SDI and HD OUT3

  1. 2026.07.15

    Checking the SDI outputs

    We checked the S700 output configuration on site and prepared the conversion path.

  2. 2026.08.04

    12G-SDI · Overlapping views

    With the 3D option enabled, we connected the 12G-SDI output to the Mac through a converter and capture card. The captured left and right views appeared superimposed.

  3. 2026.08.06

    HD OUT3 · SBS received

    After switching to the HD OUT3 recording output, we received the left and right views side by side in one SBS frame. The Mac app captured this input and streamed it to Galaxy XR.

Splitting HD OUT3 for recording and XR

We used an SDI splitter on the HD OUT3 signal connected to the recorder. One branch kept the existing recording connection; the other went to the Mac through an SDI-to-HDMI converter and a capture card.

HD OUT3
HD-SDI · Always 3D

Keeps 3D video on the recording output.

Video received by the Mac
1920×1080 · Half SBS

Both views sit side by side in a Full HD frame, with 960×1080 allocated to each eye.

Wireless streaming
H.264 · Galaxy XR

The Mac streamed at 1920×1080 across both views.

We streamed through HD OUT3 while preserving its input resolution. After surgery, we also checked the other output ports.

September 17 · Capture results by output port
OutputObservation
HD OUT3Received side-by-side 3D video
12G-SDI OUT2Received moving video, but did not confirm a side-by-side input
3G-SDI(4K) B·C·DNo usable video when each port was connected individually

Half SBS streaming settings and results

The Mac app used H.264 settings that preserved 1920×1080 across both views. The measurements below cover a continuous reception period on Galaxy XR under those settings.

2026.09.17 · Continuous reception after connecting power
MetricGalaxy XR log
Analysis duration21 min 13.769 sec
Effective received image1920×1080 · Both views combined
Average decoded frame rateAbout 59.82fps
Average received bitrate20.102Mbps
Freezes detected in the log4 · About 0.97 sec total
Dropped frames36

The input was Half SBS, with half the frame width allocated to each eye. Because the input already limited the available detail, raising the streaming resolution made little visible difference in sharpness.

We are reviewing the 3D format of the 12G-SDI output and the capture setup, with the aim of receiving Full SBS.
